raw:
Rubens Barrichello drove for Brawn only in 2009, and he won 2 races that season: the European Grand Prix at Valencia and the Italian Grand Prix at Monza.

I checked his result in each of the 17 rounds of the 2009 season. He finished second in Australia, Spain and Monaco, and third in Britain, but did not win those. In the other rounds he finished between 4th and 10th, and Jenson Button won Turkey. The 2009 calendar had no Canadian Grand Prix, so no round is missing.

ANSWER: 2
